behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert some(undefined) differs from none and explicit error retains thrown identity.
Assert default-mode packet lookalikes stay direct and malformed tagged packets reject.
docDelivery: Explain opt-in versus legacy direct values and undefined fallback.
Document some/none/error own fields, extra fields, unchanged values and no eager fallback/awaiting.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Direct arbitrary values; explicit tagged own-data ordinary packets, malformed protocol rejection; options boolean tagged; no getters/proxies.
independence: Add tagged optional results to a consumer while preserving legacy direct values and explicit failure tags.
